academic.textKo: 국제지원 페이지는 모든 중등·고등교육 성적표와 해당 채점 기준을 요구합니다. 수치형 신입생 학업 최저 기준은 확인되지 않았습니다.

testing.text: WMU’s current international FAQ says SAT/ACT are not required for international admission; scores can support mathematics placement and honors invitations.
testing.textKo: 현재 국제지원 FAQ는 SAT/ACT가 국제학생 입학의 필수 요건이 아니며 수학 배치 및 아너스 초청에 활용될 수 있다고 명시합니다.

entry.text: The official department lists Literature and Language, Creative Writing, and Rhetoric and Writing Studies majors. These are documented options, not proven least-selective majors.
entry.textKo: 공식 학과는 문학·언어, 문예창작, 수사학·글쓰기 전공을 제시합니다. 확인된 전공 목록이며 가장 입학하기 쉬운 전공으로 입증된 것은 아닙니다.

applicantScope.text: International first-year applicant; university evaluates foreign credentials. English proficiency, final graduation and program requirements remain separate.
applicantScope.textKo: 국제 신입생 지원 기준입니다. 대학의 해외 성적 평가, 영어 능력, 최종 졸업 및 전공 요건을 별도로 충족해야 합니다.

notes: Do not encode the 2025 SAT 1060 route as verified current eligibility: the current international admissions webpage lists only GPA 2.25 or top 50%.
Fourteen additional universities researched using institution-owned official sources. No Ontario GPA conversion or admission odds were inferred.
Only Northern Iowa has a verified Ontario credential specific percentage minimum in this batch:75 cumulative in secondary academic subjects; not top-six Grade 12.
Wichita State has an explicit current international SAT alternative 1060 with each section 490. Overall SAT scores alone cannot determine section eligibility.

University of South Dakota specialized international page gives SAT 1070 OR GPA 2.6, but the generic page differs; satAlternative.verificationStatus is conflicting-sources. Exclude this from an automated confirmed-eligibility list until resolved.
Missouri Southern 2025 officialPDF gives SAT 1060 as alternative, but current webpage omits it; no structured current SAT alternative encoded.
All entry.easierMajorVerified values are false: a documented broad major is not proof of the least-selective major.
Ranks are null unless an institutional source explicitly identifies the 2026 U.S.News National Universities category and numeric position. Regional rankings must not be mixed into that ranking.
SAT ranges were left null rather than use an undated statistic or add section percentiles. These schools can be reference-pool entries, not fabricated grade × SAT fit matches.
TargetFall 2028 is unconfirmed except where a source explicitly extends policy; current and 2026–27 requirements must be labeled accordingly.
